author: FRONTLINE PBS | Official
description:
What happened after Rachel and Dan Christensen reported concerns about their adoption process?

Their concerns became part of an investigation into a multimillion-dollar operation using unlicensed middlemen to recruit pregnant Marshallese women. Watch Part 3 of our series “Their adoption exposed a ‘baby mill,’” drawn from FRONTLINE and Retro Report’s documentary Baby Brokers.
title: They Helped Expose an Adoption "Baby Mill" 3/3
